title: Paper-store response
कागज़ भंडार में प्रतिक्रिया
scenarios.context: Small authored paper fire; trained responder; escape route clear; training Unit A label specifically covers this scenario.

questions.prompt: Before using Unit A, what evidence matters?

choices.label: Inspect its scenario label and condition
Use the nearest unit without inspection

questions.explanation: A label and serviceable condition matter as well as the hazard and role. This Unit A is an authored example, not a universal rating.

questions.prompt: Smoke now threatens the escape route.

choices.label: Stop, withdraw and raise the alarm
Continue because the fire began small

questions.explanation: An initially suitable response becomes unsuitable when conditions worsen. Safe withdrawal is a successful decision.

title: Hidden fault at the switchboard
स्विचबोर्ड पर छिपी खराबी
scenarios.context: Authored energised electrical fire; water unit W; suitable-labelled simulation unit C has a visibly damaged hose.

questions.prompt: The suitable-labelled unit has a damaged hose.

choices.label: Reject it and report the damage
Cover the damage and use it

questions.explanation: A nominally suitable label does not make damaged equipment serviceable. Water is not the alternative for this energised scenario.

questions.prompt: No verified serviceable suitable unit remains.

choices.label: Withdraw and notify designated responders
Use water unit W to avoid delay

questions.explanation: Do not improvise a replacement agent when the scenario prerequisites fail. The app never authorises real firefighting.

title: Uncertain liquid and agent
अज्ञात द्रव और माध्यम
scenarios.context: Authored spill fire; material identity and agent rating missing; sand and an unlabelled unit are offered.

questions.prompt: Can sand be assumed suitable?

choices.label: Request the material and approved agent information
Assume sand works for every liquid

questions.explanation: Agent suitability depends on material and equipment context. The missing label and material cannot be supplied by guesswork.

questions.prompt: The material and rating remain unknown.

choices.label: Raise the alarm and withdraw
Test the unknown unit near the fire

questions.explanation: Missing information is a valid reason to refuse. No universal agent or distance is taught.

title: Outside attendant check
बाहरी निगरानी की जाँच
scenarios.context: Authored training permit lists an authorised entrant, an outside attendant, verified isolation and monitoring. No actual entry occurs.

questions.prompt: Where is the attendant positioned?

choices.label: Outside, performing assigned monitoring and communication duties
Inside alongside the entrant

questions.explanation: The attendant role is outside the space and must retain the assigned duties. This is simulated role recognition.

questions.prompt: The team has not tested its withdrawal signal.

choices.label: Check communication before the simulated next stage
Assume the team will hear shouting

questions.explanation: A documented plan still needs the required communication checks. Simulation completion never grants an entry permit.

title: Communication interruption
संचार में बाधा
scenarios.context: Authored team communication fails; the entry supervisor and designated rescue contact are available outside.

questions.prompt: What has changed?

choices.label: A required communication control has failed
Silence proves the entrant is safe

questions.explanation: Loss of communication is changing information, not evidence that all is well.

questions.prompt: A simulated colleague collapses inside.

choices.label: Raise the alarm and summon designated rescue; do not enter untrained
Enter alone immediately

questions.explanation: A rushed untrained entry rescue can create another casualty. The drill rewards reporting and staying within role.

title: Incomplete monitoring information
अधूरी निगरानी जानकारी
scenarios.context: Virtual meter shows SIM; required instrument checks and monitoring interpretation are absent.

questions.prompt: What does SIM establish?

choices.label: Only a simulated training cue; no actual atmosphere measurement
That the real air is safe

questions.explanation: The phone cannot measure gas or oxygen. The display is not calibrated safety evidence.

questions.prompt: Instrument condition and entry prerequisites remain unconfirmed.

choices.label: Refuse entry and escalate missing information
Enter because there is no smell

questions.explanation: Smell cannot confirm safety. Missing verified prerequisites remain a stop condition.

title: Stored-energy recognition
संग्रहित ऊर्जा पहचान
scenarios.context: Authored press procedure identifies electrical supply and stored hydraulic energy. Authorised personnel perform isolation.

questions.prompt: Is the stop control enough?

choices.label: No; the identified sources require authorised isolation and verification
Yes; a stopped press has no energy

questions.explanation: A stopped machine can retain energy. The authored inventory is specific to this example.

questions.prompt: The pressure-release verification record is missing.

choices.label: Hold the task and request the authorised verification
Clear the jam because power is off

questions.explanation: Do not invent a release technique. Verification follows the exact approved machinery procedure.

title: Missing conveyor guard
कन्वेयर की सुरक्षा गायब
scenarios.context: Authored conveyor has an exposed pinch point and missing guard; a supervisor requests speed.

questions.prompt: What observation matters?

choices.label: The missing guard exposes an unsafe condition
The supervisor wants a fast finish

questions.explanation: Production pressure does not erase a missing safeguard.

questions.prompt: The guard cannot be restored by the learner.

choices.label: Stop and report to the authorised team
Bypass the guard for one cycle

questions.explanation: The learner works within their role. The app provides no maintenance authority.

title: Uncertain shift handover
अधूरी शिफ्ट जानकारी
scenarios.context: Authored isolation lock remains; incoming shift has no verified handover record or lock-removal authority.

questions.prompt: Does a shift change permit lock removal?

choices.label: No; protection and responsibility must be transferred under the approved process
Yes; the previous worker has gone home

questions.explanation: A new shift does not itself establish lock-removal authority.

questions.prompt: Restart is requested before protection continuity is confirmed.

choices.label: Keep the task stopped and obtain authorised handover checks
Restart and document the handover later

questions.explanation: The original isolation must not be bypassed to meet a schedule. The drill does not specify a live removal procedure.

title: Dust-task limitations
धूल कार्य की सीमाएँ
scenarios.context: Authored coal/mica task has a specified protection set; its respirator requires specialist fit testing not confirmed by this phone.

questions.prompt: Can choosing the right virtual respirator establish fit?

choices.label: No; separately validated fit testing remains necessary
Yes; the phone image proves a seal

questions.explanation: Virtual selection checks recognition, not a real fit or exposure measurement.

questions.prompt: The task assessment specifies controls beyond PPE.

choices.label: Check the required controls and supervision as well
Treat PPE as removal of all dust risk

questions.explanation: PPE has limits. The scenario refers to its actual task assessment rather than inventing exposure limits.

title: Damaged strap inspection
खराब पट्टे का निरीक्षण
scenarios.context: Authored protection item has a damaged strap; an undamaged approved replacement is available.

questions.prompt: Which fault must be recognised?

choices.label: The strap damage affects the condition check
The item colour is unfashionable

questions.explanation: Inspection focuses on a meaningful condition defect rather than cosmetic preference.

questions.prompt: What is the appropriate simulated decision?

choices.label: Reject the damaged item and obtain the approved replacement
Tie a knot and assume equivalent protection

questions.explanation: Improvised repair is not a verified replacement. Use the equipment-specific approved process.

title: Uncertain steel-task protection
इस्पात कार्य की अनिश्चित सुरक्षा
scenarios.context: Authored steel task combines noise and heat; item compatibility and fitting guidance are missing.

questions.prompt: Do individually selected items guarantee a suitable combination?

choices.label: No; compatibility and fit information are required
Yes; more items always mean more protection

questions.explanation: Protection items can affect one another. Missing compatibility cannot be inferred.

questions.prompt: The required guidance is still unavailable.

choices.label: Stop the task and ask the authorised supervisor
Proceed using an unverified combination

questions.explanation: The drill rewards refusal when required protection information is absent.

title: Clear route and muster
खुला रास्ता और एकत्र स्थल
scenarios.context: Authored map marks route A clear and a designated assembly point; the learner has an evacuation role only.

questions.prompt: Which information determines this drill route?

choices.label: The current designated clear route on this authored map
The route memorised in a previous arrangement

questions.explanation: Transfer means reading current cues. The virtual map is not real-site navigation.

questions.prompt: At assembly, someone is unaccounted for.

choices.label: Report the missing-person information to the responsible person
Leave assembly and search inside

questions.explanation: Accountability and reporting stay within the learner’s role.

title: Changed evacuation route
बदला निकासी रास्ता
scenarios.context: Authored route A becomes blocked; route B is currently marked designated and clear.

questions.prompt: What changed from the earlier arrangement?

choices.label: The previous route is now blocked
Nothing; A was clear before

questions.explanation: Old route information is stale. Inspect the current arrangement.

questions.prompt: How should the simulated route decision change?

choices.label: Select designated clear route B and follow the drill plan
Continue towards blocked A

questions.explanation: The exercise tests changed cues rather than memorised button positions.

title: Unconfirmed missing-person report
अपुष्ट लापता व्यक्ति की जानकारी
scenarios.context: Authored incident report contains a last-seen location but no confirmed safe entry route; designated responders receive the report.

questions.prompt: What should the handover distinguish?

choices.label: Observed last-seen facts from assumptions
Guess the colleague location confidently

questions.explanation: Uncertainty must stay visible in a responder handover.

questions.prompt: Does concern permit an untrained entry search?

choices.label: No; withdraw, report and hand over to designated responders
Yes; enter without the required role or route

questions.explanation: Compassion does not create rescue authorisation. Safe escalation is a successful outcome.
